description: Source code for a web page demonstrating the use of the CodeMirror editor with the panel addon. It includes HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to set up a demo interface for adding, replacing, and removing panels in the CodeMirror editor.

methods.name: makePanel
methods.description: Creates a DOM element representing a panel with a remove button and a label.

methods.name: addPanel
methods.description: Adds a new panel to the CodeMirror editor at the specified position.

methods.name: replacePanel
methods.description: Replaces an existing panel with a new one based on user input.
